answer: The recentering loss is exactly absent and an actual pointwise BT estimate follows. For every orthogonal background eta, its fully integrated fiber weight obeys Z_eta<=3*sqrt(pi/(N*omega_L^2))*exp[-N*omega_L^2*m(eta)^2/12]. An exact positive Gaussian-tube family proves that this implication cannot be obtained from curvature, center cost, symmetry, unique vacuum, unit center shear, and extensive mean action alone. A BT-specific normalized cross-section estimate is still required.
